# Alchemforge

> Alchemforge Inc is a software company in Spring Valley, New York. It builds privacy-first desktop software and browser extensions, and offers workflow-automation consulting. Flagship product: Offline Bank Statement Converter, a Windows desktop app that converts PDF bank statements (digital and scanned) to CSV, XLSX and QBO entirely offline on the user's own computer.

Key facts about Offline Bank Statement Converter:
- Converts PDF bank statements — both digital PDFs and scanned paper statements (built-in OCR) — into CSV, Excel (XLSX) and QuickBooks (QBO) files.
- 100% offline: statements are processed locally and never uploaded; works with no internet connection. Suited to bookkeepers, accountants and businesses that must not upload client financial documents to cloud converter websites.
- Verification: every extracted transaction is reconciled against the statement's own printed running balances and marked Verified; unreadable rows are flagged, never silently guessed.
- Pricing: $129 one-time purchase, lifetime license for 2 computers, free updates, 14-day money-back guarantee, free tier for testing. Checkout: https://alchemforge.gumroad.com/l/iflgeir
- Platform: Windows 10 and 11.
